question: If I order one of each of the iced coffees and one of each of the cold brew coffees, what is the average price for all of the drinks? Use the cheapest specification for calculation.

steps.description: Locate the first iced coffee item in the menu and read its price
Locate the second iced coffee item in the menu and read its price
Locate the third iced coffee item in the menu and read its price
Locate the fourth iced coffee item in the menu and read its price
Locate the first cold brew coffee item in the menu and read its price
Locate the second cold brew coffee item in the menu and read its price
Add together the prices from steps 1, 2, 3, and 4 to get the total for all iced coffees
Add together the prices from steps 5 and 6 to get the total for all cold brew coffees
Combine the totals from steps 7 and 8 to get the overall price for all drinks
Count the total number of drinks: 4 iced coffees plus 2 cold brew coffees equals 6 drinks
Divide the total price from step 9 by the number of drinks from step 10 to calculate the average price
